1) the best results are achieved by using distributional similarity as re-ranking feature, 2) the results improve when using lemmatized forms instead of inflected forms, 3) the best results in terms of precision are achieved when applying a combination of re-ordering rules.

1) the use of distributional similarity as an additional ranking feature leads to an improved extraction of particle verb synonyms; 2) the extraction of particle verb synonym is robust to different pre-processing strategies; 3) the use of language model scores is not as successful as distributional similarity in improving the quality of extracted particle verb synonyms.

the combination of distributional similarity and translation probability as a re-ranking criterion leads to a better performance than translation probability alone, and that the combination of lemmatized and inflected input leads to better performance than using inflected forms alone.
